text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired for service `inference-gateway` (P3)
incident: <https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD123456|PD123456>
Triggered by: latency spikes > 2000ms from gateway-prod, 05:12 UTC

matt choi: I just got a page. I think this went to platform-oncall by mistake — I'm infra-oncall right now but not on the inference gateway service. Anyone else see this?

sarah wang: I also received PD. Confirmed it's routing to platform-oncall (my rota). I don't own that service. @olivia tan any cfg changes overnight?

olivia tan: We rolled out an oncall schedule tweak last night to support APAC rotations. Looks like the `service-tag:platform` was accidentally applied to the `inference-gateway` binding in pagerduty-sync. Investigating.

pagerduty-bot: PD: Incident PD123456 acknowledged by sarah wang @ 05:14 UTC

carla ng: If the wrong team is getting pages, we should reassign and then pause escalation rules. @matt can you take it once reassigned? :+1:

matt choi: Yep I'll take it. If someone can do the PD reassign to `infra-oncall@redwood` I'll ack and start triage.

sarah wang: Done. /pd reassign PD123456 --assign infra-oncall
pagerduty-bot: PD: Incident PD123456 reassigned to infra-oncall (matt choi) by sarah wang

matt choi: Acked and taking point. Quick check: is there a customer impact? I'm seeing a spike in 504s for our gateway to model-hosting between 05:10-05:16 UTC.

incident-bot: Aggregated logs (sample):
```
2026-05-20T05:12:01Z gateway-prod INF request_id=abc123 status=504 backend=host-42 latency_ms=2301
2026-05-20T05:12:03Z gateway-prod INF request_id=def456 status=200 backend=host-17 latency_ms=230
```

olivia tan: Looks like a small subset of traffic routed to a degrading host pool. No full-customer outage in metrics; a handful of customers saw elevated token latency. I'll roll back the schedule tag to unblock routing.

oncall-rotation-bot: oncall-sync: last override applied 2026-05-19T23:40 UTC by olivia.tan — changed `service_tags` mapping. Suggest revert: `pagerduty-sync set service_tags inference-gateway:infra` to correct.

matt choi: Re-routed traffic away from host-42 and warmed cache on model-serving. Latency back to baseline 05:20 UTC. Continuing smoke tests.

carla ng: Noted customer impact: 0.3% of requests in last 10m had >2s latency, no errors other than timeouts. Opening follow-up ticket: INFRA-4652 (pd-sync schedule bug + safer deploy guard).

sarah wang: Good catch. Action items: 1) revert PD tag (done) 2) add validation to schedule sync 3) run a rotation-replay test on staging.

matt choi: Marking incident as mitigated — continuing monitoring. :white_check_mark:

olivia tan: I'll follow up with a postmortem and include a rollback checklist and a canary on pagerduty-sync. Thanks all for quick handoff.

carla ng: assigning follow-up: @olivia @matt @sarah

incident-bot: Incident PD123456 status: Mitigated by matt choi at 05:21 UTC
